faqs.question: Which IPMAT coaching has the best faculty experience in India?
faqs.answer: On this CoachingCompare audit, T.I.M.E. leads for named IPMAT mentors at selected centres, then IMS, Rodha, Career Launcher, Tutor Uncle, PW Live, and Aapt Prep. Always request the mentor list in writing.

faqs.question: Should I ask for faculty names before joining IPMAT coaching?
faqs.answer: Yes. Request QA and verbal mentor names, ask whether the same faculty teach your batch all year, and sit a demo. National chains may rotate centre directors.

faqs.question: How do I contact T.I.M.E. for IPMAT?
faqs.answer: Phone +91-40-40088400, email info@time4education.com, time4education.com. Confirm the local centre teaches IPMAT before you travel.

faqs.question: Is a national brand or an online academy better for IPMAT faculty?
faqs.answer: National brands (TIME, IMS, Career Launcher) help if you need a local centre—confirm the IPMAT roster. Online brands (Rodha, PW Live, Tutor Uncle) suit live-first learners—verify who teaches your slot.

faqs.question: Are these faculty ranks sponsored?
faqs.answer: No. CoachingCompare does not sell #1 positions. Faculty Experience reordering reflects published mentor continuity—not advertising fees.
